card.name: Words before CYP inducer or inhibitor
card.fires_on: Modifiers such as known, potent or strong right before the words inducer or inhibitor of a CYP enzyme in drug-interaction text. Also the number inside CYP450.

modes.label: Strength modifier
modes.description: An adjective like potent, strong or known after 'is a' or 'that are', just before inducer or inhibitor.
modes.example: carbamazepine is a<< potent>> inducer of CYP1A2

modes.label: Inside CYP name
modes.description: The digit in a CYP450 enzyme name just before inhibitor.

card.writes: It pushes toward agent-role nouns such as catalyst, recorder or translator, so it predicts a role noun like inducer or inhibitor next.
card.plain: It fires on words like potent or known that come just before the label inducer or inhibitor of a liver enzyme.
